skillFull: Casts Cookies from the streets to become punk fashion models at given intervals. The Cookies are located at different heights, and are cast by using the platforms to reach them. When all Cookies are cast, a stage appear(sic) and the Cookies walk up on it. Press both buttons repeatedly to turn the Cookies. After turning the Cookies a certain amount, they put on punk fashion clothing, earning Punk Fashion Points. Level Up for more Cookie Casting Points and Punk Fashion Points.
story: What do you get when you combine currant fruit as dark as the night, and light, soft cream, delicate like the sunlight of spring? Chaos itself, of course! That intense acidity that makes your mouth water and the soft sweetness of cream meets to create the most unique Cookie you've ever seen. A rebel of the fashion world who refuses to be limited in her self-expression, it's Currant Cream Cookie! Crown Punky's signature designs include t-shirts decorated with dangerously sharp studs or shocking strawberry jam splatter. This up-and-coming designer, who has started to gain popularity with the Cookies of the in-crowd, is also famous for her outspoken attempts to turn punk rock concert stages into runways, and her two-sided mysterious smile. Everything has a dark side, and it definitely seems like this Cookie has a secret of some kind... Cookies are not just what they present to the world after all!
quote: The punk mentality that breaks down prejudice, now that's fashion!
